newsitem.title: USA: Styling Technology mulling acquisition candidates.
newsitem.headline: Styling Technology mulling acquisition candidates.

text.p: Styling Technology Corp chairman and chief executive Sam Leopold told shareholders at the annual meeting today that the company was continuing to consider attractive acquisition candidates.
Styling Technology last month reported net income of $1.1 million, or $0.26 per share, on sales of $7.5 million for the first quarter of 1997.

There were no comparable figures because the company began operations as a public company in November. Styling Technology develops, produces and markets professional salon products, including hair-care, nail-care and skin and body-care products as well as salon appliances and salonwear.
